summary: First iteration. Backend: all 24 pytest tests PASSED (auth register/login/me, onboard, metrics today/history (7/14/30), tips generate for all 5 focuses with Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM Key, tips list ordering, auth security 401s, demo account). Frontend: welcome→register→onboarding(3 steps)→dashboard works end-to-end, welcome→login→dashboard works (skip onboarding for onboarded user), all 4 tabs render (Hoje, Histórico, Dicas, Perfil) with all required cards and testIDs, history range/metric switching works, AI tip generation persists tips in list, token persists across page reloads. ONE BUG FOUND: profile logout button does not work on web preview because it uses React Native Alert.alert (not implemented on RN Web), so token is never cleared and navigation never happens.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses Alert.alert which is NOT implemented on React Native Web. The confirmation modal never appears, so onPress callback (logout + router.replace) never fires. As a result clicking 'Terminar sessão' on web preview does nothing — auth_token stays in localStorage and the user remains on dashboard. Verified: localStorage.auth_token still present after click; dashboard still visible; URL stays /profile.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN-Web warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated', transform-origin DOM property, onStartShouldSetResponder unknown handler. These are RN-Web internals (likely from CircularRing/SVG or Pressable), do not break functionality but pollute the console. Optionally migrate style.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents prop, etc.

action_items: Replace Alert.alert in app/(tabs)/profile.tsx confirmLogout with a Platform-aware confirm: on web use window.confirm() (or a custom Modal), on native keep Alert.alert. Example: `const ok = Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm('Sair? Tens a certeza?') : await new Promise(r => Alert.alert(...,[{text:'Cancelar',onPress:()=>r(false)},{text:'Sair',onPress:()=>r(true)}]));` then `if (ok) { await logout(); router.replace('/welcome'); }`.

Optional: update /app/memory/test_credentials.md — the demo account is actually onboarded=false (verified via /api/auth/login). Either re-seed demo to onboarded=true, or update the doc to say 'demo user requires onboarding on each fresh DB'.
Optional: silence RN-Web pointerEvents and transform-origin warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is monolithic (~410 LoC) but acceptable for MVP. Consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/metrics.py, routers/tips.py if it grows.
Emergent LLM key call path is well-wrapped in try/except with a tasteful PT-language fallback per focus — confirmed working both ways.
Mongo _id correctly excluded via projection {_id: 0} everywhere — good.
JWT_SECRET, MONGO_URL, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY all read from env — good.
auth.tsx logout() correctly clears token; bug is purely in profile.tsx using Alert.alert on web.
seed_data_creation: Created two fresh test users during testing (test+<ts>@pulse.app and test+ui<ts>@pulse.app) plus generated AI tips for the demo user. All seeded via real API; no manual DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes Profile logout for web, retest: tap 'Terminar sessão' → should accept confirm → land on /welcome → localStorage auth_token should be null → reload should keep user on welcome. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_pulse_api.py can be reused: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pulse_api.py -v`.
rca_of_issue: RCA: React Native's Alert.alert API is a noop on react-native-web (the web shim does not render a dialog). Profile.confirmLogout wraps logout()+router.replace inside Alert.alert's onPress, so on web nothing happens. Reproduction: Login as demo → Perfil tab → click 'Terminar sessão' → no modal, no nav, token still in localStorage. Mitigation: gate by Platform.OS — use window.confirm on web or a custom RN <Modal> that works cross-platform.
